verdict: Only with a niche. Pharmallama pitched a simplified pharmacy on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from all five sharks. Online pharmacy is dominated by large, well-funded players, so a new entrant needs a focus such as chronic-care subscriptions or a specific region.
angle: Patients with chronic conditions buy the same medicines every month and value reminders and delivery. A licensed pharmacy with pharmacist support and subscriptions can build loyalty. Regulations for online pharmacies are still evolving.
